Zota Health Care LImited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors at its meeting held on Jun 10, 2019, have inter alia, discussed and approved:1. Recommended the issuance of fully paid Bonus Share in the ratio of 4:10 [i.e. 4 (Four) fully paid up equity shares for every 10 (Ten) equity shares held], subject to the shareholder��s approval.2. Increased the Authorised Share Capital of the Company from Rs. 20,00,00,000 (Rupees Twenty Crore Only) divided into 2,00,00,000 (Two Crore) equity shares of Rs. 10/- each to Rs. 25,00,00,000 (Rupees Twenty Five Crore Only) divided into 2,50,00,000 (Two Crore Fifty Lacs) equity shares of Rs. 10/- each by creation of additional 50,00,000 (Fifty Lakh) equity shares of Rs. 10/- each, subject to the shareholder��s approval.3. Considered and approved notice convening an Extraordinary General Meeting (EGM) of the Company to be held on Friday, the 12th July, 2019 at the registered office of the Company situated at Zota House, 2/896, Hira Modi Street, Sagrampura, Surat - 395002, Gujarat at 11:00 A.M. to transact the businesses sited in the said EGM Notice. 4. For EGM Board has decided Friday, 05th July, 2019 as a cut-off date for the purpose of e-voting. Member��s whose names appear on register of members as on Friday, 05th July, 2019 shall be eligible for e-voting. E-voting will be start on Tuesday, 09th July, 2019 and will end on Thursday, 11th July, 2019. Board has also appointed PCS Ranjit Kejriwal as a scrutinizer for scrutinizing e-voting and conduct poll though ballot paper during EGM of the Company.
